messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Real-time detector flagged spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (pct >= 4.5% over 3m). Paging oncall for inference-prod.
sandra: Oncall here. Thanks. I'm pulling the live tail and infra dashboard now.
omar: I can help with routing/fallbacks if needed. Any customer-facing symptoms yet?
sandra: Grafana shows per-region error spike in us-east-1, latency up ~200ms. Error is 502 from embedder service to runtime.
ken: Seeing the same in traces — a surge of KV cache misses correlating with a backend shard eviction.
sandra: quick mitigation — enabling aggressive prefix cache for hot prefixes and pinning model variant fallback. Doing change now.
omar: FYI I've queued a routing fallback to smaller model pool (canary) as a safety net. If sandra ok, I'll push.
sandra: do it. Need to keep user-facing error rate below SLA threshold.
ryan: Customer impact check: product-ops dashboard shows ~1.2k requests affected in last 10m, mostly free-tier but some mid-market tenants. Not yet a full outage but visible retry storms.
product-bot: Notifying product incident channel and creating INC-2026-311 in pager duty.
sandra: Mitigation applied: prefix cache toggled, model fallback active. Error rate dropping to ~1.1% in us-east-1.
ken: Traces show reduced 5xx after fallback, but tail latency still elevated on large-seq requests.
omar: Can we throttle long-seq requests temporarily? Maybe apply per-route max_tokens limit for non-enterprise tiers.
maria: I'll draft a customer comms blurb for impacted tenants, stating degraded performance and ongoing remediation. @ryan will review.
ryan: Reviewed, small edit. We'll send targeted message to impacted mid-market tenants after postmortem scheduling.
sandra: Looks like root cause is a latent bug in the K/V eviction logic under concurrent re-sharding. Repro steps in my notes.
ken: I can own a remediation PR to make eviction idempotent and add a metric guard. Estimate ~3-4d of effort (includes QA + canary).
omar: I'll own the short-term routing policy change formalization + a playbook update. Estimate 1-2d to implement and test in staging.
maria: I'll own comms and postmortem writeup skeleton. 0.5d to prepare initial draft.
ryan: Prioritization: severity = Sev3 (customer-visible degradation, not full outage). This needs Q2 sprint tie-in. Recommend one small hotfix in next sprint, and a larger eviction hardening in the following sprint.
sandra: Agree. Action items list (from thread):
- ACTION-1: ken -> Eviction idempotency fix + metric guard (3-4d)
- ACTION-2: omar -> Routing fallback policy + playbook update (1-2d)
- ACTION-3: maria + ryan -> Customer comms + impacted tenant notifications (0.5d)
- ACTION-4: sandra -> Postmortem writeup + repro steps + perf regression tests (1d)

ken: I'll break ACTION-1 into ABIs:
  - ABI-1a: unit fix + tests (1d)
  - ABI-1b: staging canary + perf run (1d)
  - ABI-1c: rollout + monitoring (1d)
  => total 3d, add buffer -> 4d.
omar: ACTION-2 ABIs:
  - ABI-2a: policy config + e2e test harness (0.5d)
  - ABI-2b: staged rollout (0.5d)
  => 1d total, but keep 2d if QA queue heavy.
sandra: For prioritization across the org: mark ACTION-1 as P0 for infra backlog this sprint, ACTION-2 as P1, comms as P2 since we sent temporary lines already.
ryan: I'll create tickets and map to sprint board with the above priorities. Also will flag for Q2 planning rubric to allocate a dedicated story for eviction hardening.
maria: Postmortem schedule — let's do a 60m review tomorrow at 11:00 PT. I'll create calendar invite and link the draft.
sandra: I'll attach logs and repro script to the postmortem doc before the meeting.
ken: Quick note — add a metric: kv_eviction_concurrency_count and an alert for >10 sustained.
omar: I'll add the metric + dashboard tile as part of ACTION-2 ABIs.
product-bot: Postmortem INC-2026-311 scheduled: 2026-04-18 18:00 UTC. Tickets created: INF-5493 (eviction hardening), INF-5494 (routing policy), OPS-2219 (customer comms).
sandra: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread updated with playbook changes and canary results.
ryan: Follow-ups: we'll review sprint assignments in tomorrow's triage. If anything blocks the hotfix, escalate to infra triage.
maria: Draft comms sent to #product-ops for signoff. ETA 2h.
ken: PR opened for ABI-1a -> link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2156 (:thumbsup: needs review)
sandra: Marking thread as handoff -> post-incident action tracking. Closing live mitigation phase.
product-bot: Closing incident live phase; moving to remediation backlog. Reminder: attach SLA impact calc to postmortem.
